# Tracking-based Stabilization Quality

Use when stabilization introduces warping/wobble or when choosing settings.

## Checklist
- Pick stabilization type appropriate for motion
- Reduce strength if edges wobble
- Decide crop/reframe strategy and keep it consistent

## QC
- Edge warping, jello, wobble
- Sudden jumps from over-aggressive smoothing

## Relationship to stabilize-first
- Stabilize-first is workflow; this skill is quality tuning.

## References
- Use `docs/editing_books_structure.json` to locate stabilization topics in `Editing-Books/`.
- Convert into original settings + QC guidance.
